checks.name: Every spot reachable

checks.name: No navmesh islands
checks.rule: ground-level components other than the main one < 2 m²

checks.name: Every live spot has its mirror twins
checks.rule: same kind within 1.0 m of each symmetry image

checks.name: Spots meet the navmesh at mirrored points
checks.rule: each spot's navmesh point vs its twin's, mirrored back: <= 1 m

checks.hint: fix the constant so the twin matches
checks.name: Spot constants mirror
checks.rule: every position constant of preview_level.gd: all entries have a twin under each symmetry (+-0.05 m) with the same kind / sizes / timings, or the list is one-sided (mirrored in code)

checks.name: Navmesh mirrors itself
checks.rule: cells walkable on one side only (1-cell edge noise ignored): WARN > 0.3 %, FAIL > 2 %

checks.hint: find the unmirrored obstacle on the longer route
checks.name: Map geometry: path pairs match their mirror twins
checks.rule: octile shortest path on the 0.5 m navmesh grid, every spot pair vs its mirrored pair: WARN > 2 % (and > 0.75 m), FAIL > 5 % (and > 2 m)

checks.hint: engine path noise: a finer bake (smaller cell / edge_max_length) or path post-processing evens it
checks.name: Unit paths (NavigationServer): pairs match their twins
checks.rule: NavigationServer3D.map_get_path length, every spot pair vs its mirrored pair: INFO > 2 % (and > 0.75 m), WARN > 5 % (and > 2 m); the polygon A* is not mirrored, so this is how much the engine's path choice (not the map) favours a side

checks.name: Keep to nearest camp / point / expansion... equal per seat
checks.rule: per kind, the seats' nearest path lengths differ <= 2 %

checks.name: Ally keeps: equal, close, on their bank
checks.rule: ally path equal per side (<= 2 %), <= 1.25 x the nearest enemy keep

checks.name: Travel times per seat (worker / soldier / cavalry / caravan)
checks.rule: path length / UnitType.move_speed with fords and steps at -35 %; seats' times per destination within 3 s (and 3 %)

checks.name: Crossing widths
checks.rule: navmesh width across each crossing >= 2.0 m and equal to its twin (+-0.5 m)

checks.name: Main routes: narrowest corridor matches the twin
checks.rule: keep -> crown / enemy keep / nearest expansion: the narrowest navmesh width along the path differs from the mirrored route's by <= 1.0 m

checks.name: Heat map (sum of all shortest paths)
checks.value: heatmap.png written (704 x 704 px, 4 px per metre; grey navmesh, blue islands, yellow -> red path use, dots = spots)
